concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-pix-api-only]] — 2026-09-15-captured Pix API-only BR/BRL guide for shopper data, versioned payment expiry, Pending QR action, asynchronous webhook example, refunds and test/live gates; source flags example amount and field-requiredness caveats.
warnings: Pending qrCode response is not final paid status; the success webhook is a separate illustrative example.
The webhook sample amount 100000 differs from the payment request sample 10000; no overpayment/reconciliation behavior is specified.
The form prose calls for Name and CPF/CNPJ while the /payments table leaves shopperName and socialSecurityNumber unmarked and subsequently advises both; do not overstate requiredness.
The generic capture step does not establish separate or partial capture support, which the Pix overview matrix marks unavailable.
